actions.reason: Strong biological support: RNA shows FDR-significant upregulation of interferon/inflammatory pathways with large effect sizes, and WXS shows significant BAP1 enrichment (q=0.0044). Cross-modal consistency is moderate with median support count 3 and positive RNA/WSI silhouettes. Confounder exclusion shows a significant site enrichment (CJ) but this is a single technical factor and does not override the coherent biological signal. No better-supported structural action or resolvable evidence gap exists.

Biological support is absent: no significant RNA, WXS, or CNV enrichment (all q near 1.0). Cross-modal consistency is driven almost entirely by CT (median silhouette 0.276) with weak or negative support from other modalities, and confounder exclusion reveals strong technical associations with CT manufacturer/scanner/kernel (q<0.05). The set appears to be a technical artifact rather than a biological subtype. No structural split or merge is supported, and no available evidence can resolve the technical confounding.

Biological support is absent: no significant RNA, WXS, or CNV enrichment (all q high). Cross-modal consistency is weak with near-zero silhouettes in most modalities and low patient support (median 2). Confounder exclusion shows no significant technical associations, but the lack of any biological signal and weak structural cohesion do not support a distinct identity. No structural split or merge is supported, and no available evidence can resolve the gap.

Biological support is strong: RNA shows 25 significant pathways with large effect sizes (e.g., allograft rejection down, heme metabolism up), and CNV shows five significant lower copy-number features (q<0.05). Cross-modal consistency is moderate with positive WSI and RNA silhouettes and high resampling ARI (0.561). Confounder exclusion shows no significant per-set technical associations (q=0.065 trends only). The biological signal is coherent across RNA and CNV, and no better-supported structural action or resolvable gap exists.

Biological support is moderate: RNA shows 18 significant pathways with large effect sizes (e.g., coagulation up, EMT up), though WXS and CNV are not significant. Cross-modal consistency is weak overall but RNA provides some support (median silhouette 0.021). Confounder exclusion shows no significant per-set technical associations. The transcriptional profile provides a defensible identity, and no structural split or merge is supported. The lack of genomic support is uncertainty, not contradiction, and no available evidence can resolve it.
